title: KnowBench: Effort Reduction as a Unified, Deployment-Grounded Benchmark for Clinical AI
reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向
missingSignals: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
报告基线或多个模型的评测
材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）
给出任务规模或覆盖范围
讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: ER is defined once and instantiated per task across the administrative workload clinical AI automates: visit notes, diagnosis and billing codes, orders, EHR chart summarization, patient after-visit summaries, and clinical decision support.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Clinical AI systems are evaluated with instruments built for research settings (reference-based similarity metrics and expert rubric panels) that measure resemblance to an artifact rather than reduction of a burden.
